name: Account Locked
description: Explains that password sign-in is temporarily blocked for the identified account and offers recovery or alternate authentication paths.

web.implementation: SigninLockedOutComponent with signin-locked-out.component.html; AuthRoutePaths.signInLockedOut is registered and password login routes AUTH030 here.

conformance.notes: Verified auth.sign-in.locked-out screen identity and all five canonical actions/finders against SigninLockedOutComponent and its template.

mobile.implementation: app/auth/continue/email/locked-out.tsx -> AuthOutcomeScreen; password sign-in preserves AUTH030 as locked-out and routes here.

conformance.notes: Verified /auth/continue/email/locked-out uses the canonical screen identity and all five canonical semantic actions/finders.

notes: This surface is intentionally distinct from auth.sign-in.unable because lockout is a canonical account-state outcome with different next actions.
Presentation must not disclose security details beyond the fact that password sign-in is currently blocked.
